notes: Variant unit WLC.1SA.10.7.v001 is underdetermined and its base reading `תָבֹאנָה` is compatible with the ASV's *are come*; no fallback exclusion arises (rules 9, 53).
The ethical dative `לְךָ` and its suffix are both unrepresented under rule 40's closing sentences; the *thee* of *serve thee* answers to the suffix on `יָדֶךָ`.
The apodosis `עֲשֵׂה` writes no waw, so the presentative frame keeps its complementizer *that* (rule 45).
